cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: BRIX Atlas ships a 24-language interface and a measured multilingual RAG pipeline. Two structural defects were found and fixed by treating language as an engineering concern rather than a label: ADR-0016 corrects chat-template prompt formatting, and ADR-0017 keeps the language directive out of the retrieval query, which had been poisoning embedding similarity and failing every non-English question before generation began. Generation quality outside English is not yet reliable and is reported as such in docs/evaluation/multilingual-rag-retrieval-2026-08-10.md; language_scope is therefore declared as English only. The pairing is load-bearing engineering, not a marketing claim.
